### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => { const before = await page.locator("article").count(); await page.getByRole("button", { name: "清除聊天" }).click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); const after = await page.locator("article").count(); return {before, after, text: (await page.locator("body").innerText()).slice(0,2000)}; })(page);
```
### Page
- Page URL: http://127.0.0.1:5175/
### Modal state
- ["confirm" dialog with message "清除当前聊天记录？不会删除已保存报告。"]: can be handled by browser_handle_dialog
